name: Sign Up
next: Create account → Onboarding Wizard

notes.text: → System: creates a tenant (business account) with this user as Owner. Every query is scoped by tenant ID.
Owner needs a passkey or 2FA (lost-phone edge case).

name: Onboarding Wizard
next: Finish or "Skip for now" → Dashboard (resume from its checklist)

notes.text: Skippable and resumable. Step 3 (Packages) creates the Silver / Gold / Platinum packages used in proposals.
Same forms are reused later in Settings (Business, Branding, Packages, Payments, Calendar, Templates).

name: Dashboard
next: Tap an alert → Contract (countersign) or Leads; tap an event → Event Hub

notes.text: Answers "what needs me today?", which is success metric #1 in the spec. Every alert links to the screen that fixes it.

name: Calendar
next: Tap an event → Event Hub · tap a hold → Lead Detail · Week/Day = same data, closer zoom

notes.text: Real app color-codes by event type and status. Lo-fi uses labels and dashed borders for holds.
→ System: 2-way sync with Google/Apple/Outlook; holds auto-expire; conflict checks for you, staff and travel time.

name: New lead notification
from: Ana submits the Inquiry Form (Client journey #1)
next: Tap → Lead Detail (Rivera)

notes.text: → System (lead.created): push + dashboard card + calendar conflict check + auto-reply to Ana.

name: Leads (kanban)
next: Tap a card → Lead Detail · drag card to change stage

notes.text: Cards move automatically: proposal sent → "Proposal sent"; contract signed → "Won".

name: Lead Detail
next: Send booking link → ✉ to Ana · after the consult: Create Proposal → Proposal Builder

notes.text: "Send canned reply" opens an editable template in Messages. "Create Proposal" carries all lead data over. No retyping.
→ System: a date hold blocks the calendar and auto-expires after X days.

name: Proposal Builder
next: Send → ✉ "Your proposal" email to Ana (Client journey) · lead moves to "Proposal sent"

notes.text: ◇ = optional upgrade the client can tick in their portal. Totals exclude unticked upgrades.
→ System: checks gear availability on Jun 12; keeps every version; the client always sees the latest.

name: Contract (countersign)
next: Countersign → event becomes Booked → Go to Event Hub (or Invoice)

notes.text: → System (contract.countersigned): Event → Booked, hold → booking, gear reserved, checklist applied, welcome email. (Invoice + deposit already happened when Ana signed.)
Signed PDF stored with timestamps for both parties.

name: Invoice
from: Contract "View invoice" / Event Hub › Money "Open invoice"
next: Send reminder / Record payment · back → Event Hub › Money

notes.text: → System (contract.client_signed): invoice + schedule created when Ana signs. Reminders 7 days and 1 day before each due date.
Payment status always comes from Stripe/Square webhooks, never from the browser.

name: Events list
next: Tap an event → Event Hub › Overview · "+ New event" for events without a lead

notes.text: Was missing in round 1: the "Events" sidebar item led nowhere. Sorted by date; Calendar shows the same events.

name: Event Hub › Overview
from: Events list / Contract "Go to Event Hub" / Calendar
next: Tabs: Tasks · Guests · Money · Files · Messages · Change date → Reschedule · Cancel event → Cancel

notes.text: Status path: Inquiry → Proposal → Booked → In planning → Final week → Event day → Wrap-up → Closed.
Phase 2 tabs (Timeline, Vendors, Equipment…) slot into this same tab bar later.

name: Reschedule event
snap: Example: moving the wedding to Sat Jul 3 (mid-April)
from: Event Hub › Overview "Change date" / client's postpone request (Portal › Cancel or postpone)
next: Confirm → Event Hub › Overview with the new date · ✉ change notices to everyone checked

notes.text: Was a gap in round 2. Nothing changes until "Confirm"; every change is logged on the event.
→ System (event.rescheduled): relative task and payment dates shift; staff, gear, vendors rechecked; everyone checked is notified.

name: Cancel event
snap: Example: cancelled Sat Apr 10, 2027 (63 days out)
from: Event Hub › Overview "Cancel event" / client's cancel request (Portal › Cancel or postpone)
next: Confirm → event archived (restorable 30 days) · refund on Invoice · Events list

notes.text: Was a gap in round 2. Destructive, so it asks you to type CANCEL (NFR-13).
→ System: refund through the processor; gear, staff and reminders released; event archived.

name: Event Hub › Tasks
next: "Send" on a questionnaire task → ✉ to Ana → Portal › Questionnaire

notes.text: Due dates are relative to the event ("30 days before"). Client-assigned tasks show up in Ana's "Needs your action".
→ System (event.rescheduled): every relative due date shifts when the event date moves.

name: Event Hub › Guests
next: Sub-tabs → Invitations / Website & RSVP · Lock final headcount (Jun 5, after Ana approves)

notes.text: → System (rsvp.updated / headcount.locked): counts update live; locking closes RSVPs and notifies vendors.
Plus-ones are set per household here, e.g. "(+1)". Allergies are never dropped on import/export.

name: Event Hub › Guests › Website & RSVP
next: Preview as guest → Event Website · Save → Invitations sub-tab

notes.text: Was missing in round 1: this is where the RSVP's meals, plus-ones, May 1 cutoff and fund link come from.
P1: fund = external link. In-app donations/funds come in Phase 4.

name: Event Hub › Guests › Invitations
next: Request client approval → Portal › Approvals · Send → 💬 invitation text (Guest journey)

notes.text: Was missing in round 1. P1 = one simple branded template; the full Invitation Designer is Phase 3.
→ System: tracks delivered / opened / responded per guest; honors STOP opt-outs.

name: Event Hub › Money
next: Open invoice → Invoice · Add expense

notes.text: Hidden from staff unless the owner grants it. Profit is owner-only even then.

name: Event Hub › Files + Mood Board
next: Request approval → Portal › Approvals · Upload

notes.text: Each file is Shared (client sees it) or Private. Client can comment on the mood board and paste Pinterest links.

name: Event Hub › Messages
next: Reply · change order → Ana approves in Portal › Payments

notes.text: One thread with the client, one per vendor. The client never sees vendor threads unless you share.

name: Settings › Team & roles
next: Invite staff → 💬 team invite text (Staff journey) · other sections reuse the Onboarding forms

notes.text: Permissions are per person, not just per role (spec: coordinator can see budgets but not profit).
→ System: permissions are checked on the server for every request, not just by hiding buttons.

name: Inquiry Form
next: Send inquiry → ✉ auto-reply with booking link

notes.text: No account needed. Embeddable on the website, Instagram and Facebook.
→ System (lead.created): creates a Lead, checks the date, sends the auto-reply, pushes to the planner.

name: Auto-reply with booking link
next: "Pick a consult time" → Public Booking Page

notes.text: Planner can edit this template in Settings › Templates.

name: Public Booking Page
from: ✉ auto-reply "Pick a consult time" / Lead Detail "Send booking link"
next: Book → confirmation + calendar invite · consult happens Nov 2

notes.text: Like Calendly: buffer times and daily limits come from the planner's settings.
→ System: adds to both calendars; reminders 24h and 1h before.

name: Proposal email (magic link)
next: "View your proposal" → Portal › Proposal (no password)

notes.text: → System: magic link = signed one-time token; tracks when the proposal is opened.

name: Portal › Proposal
next: Accept → Portal › Contract · Request changes → planner's Proposal Builder · Ask a question → Messages

notes.text: Before the deposit, Home / Guests / Approvals are shown locked so Ana sees what's coming. Messages stays open.
→ System (proposal.accepted): contract generated from the template with merge fields filled.

name: Portal › Contract
next: Sign → "Continue to payment" → Portal › Pay (same sitting)

notes.text: → System (contract.client_signed): stores signed PDF, creates invoice + payment schedule, asks planner to countersign.

name: Portal › Pay
from: Contract "Continue to payment" / 💬 payment reminder / Payments "Pay"
next: Pay → ✉ receipt + welcome → portal unlocks

notes.text: Payments not connected? Only "pay by check/cash" shows here.
→ System (payment.succeeded): receipt email, planner alerted to countersign, portal unlocks. Planner alerted after 2 failures.

name: Receipt + welcome
next: "Open your portal" → Portal › Home (first visit: 3-screen tour)

notes.text: Ana's first portal visit shows a 3-screen tour.

name: Portal › Home
next: Each action item → Questionnaire / Approvals / Guests · Pay now → Pay

notes.text: Answers "what's next and what do I owe?" Every action item links straight to the screen that finishes it.

name: Portal › Questionnaire
from: Home "Needs your action" / ✉ "Please fill this out" from planner (Tasks "Send")
next: Submit → back to Home · answers appear on the planner's Event Hub Overview

notes.text: Was missing in round 1. Saves after every field, so Ana can stop and come back.
→ System: answers populate event fields (ceremony time, music lists…) and mark the planner's task done.

name: Portal › Mood Board
from: Sidebar "Mood Board" / ✉ "New ideas on your mood board" email
next: Comment or upload → planner sees it in Event Hub › Files · Approve board → Approvals log

notes.text: Was a gap in round 2: the portal menu had no Mood Board. Added to the menu (locked before the deposit).
→ System: comments and uploads show up on the planner's Event Hub › Files board; approval is logged.

name: Portal › Approvals
from: Sidebar / Home "Needs your action" / ✉ "Please approve" email
next: Approve / Request changes → logged; planner notified

notes.text: Split out of Home in this round (it's its own screen in the P1 inventory).
→ System: logs who approved what and when.

name: Payment reminder
from: Automatic: 7 days and 1 day before each due date
next: Tap link → Portal › Pay (Payment 2)

notes.text: Also sent by email. Autopay clients get a "we'll charge your card on Apr 13" notice instead.

name: Portal › Payments
from: Sidebar / Home "Next payment" / change order in Messages
next: Pay → Portal › Pay · Approve change order → invoice updates

notes.text: → System: an approved change order updates the invoice and the final payment.

name: Portal › Cancel or postpone
next: Send request → planner handles it in Reschedule event or Cancel event · back to Home

notes.text: Was a gap in round 2. The refund is an estimate shown before submitting; the planner confirms it.
→ System: creates a request on the planner's Dashboard alerts, linked to Reschedule / Cancel event.

name: Portal › Guests
next: Guests appear in the planner's Guest list → planner sends invitations

notes.text: Co-host (partner or parent) can get the same or limited access.
→ System: imports of 1,000+ rows run as a background job with a progress bar.

name: Portal › Messages
from: Sidebar / "Ask a question" on Proposal / ✉ new-message email
next: Reply · "Review" on a change order → Portal › Payments

notes.text: One thread with the planner. Open even before booking, so Ana can ask questions about the proposal.

name: Invitation text
from: Planner schedules invitations (Event Hub › Guests › Invitations)
next: Tap link → Invitation

notes.text: Same invite also goes by email; paper invites carry a QR to the same link.
→ System: the link carries Lucia's guest token (no login). Tracks delivered / opened.

name: Invitation (basic, P1)
from: 💬 invitation text / email / QR on paper invite
next: "View details & RSVP" → Event Website

notes.text: P1 = simple branded template. P3 adds the designer, animated envelope and music (with Skip).

name: Event Website
from: Invitation "View details & RSVP" / planner "Preview as guest"
next: RSVP → RSVP form · Honeyfund ↗ opens in a new tab

notes.text: Sections and fund link come from the planner's Website & RSVP settings. Under 2 seconds on a phone; WCAG 2.1 AA; EN/ES.

name: RSVP
next: Submit → Confirmation

notes.text: Name is prefilled from the link token. Meals, plus-ones and cutoff come from the planner's Website & RSVP settings.
Forwarded link? RSVP stays tied to the original guest; host sees a flag.

name: RSVP Confirmation
next: Add to calendar · Honeyfund ↗ · ✉ confirmation email arrives

notes.text: → System (rsvp.updated): headcount, meals, seating pool and potluck targets update; confirmation email/text; host notified if set.

name: RSVP confirmation email
next: "Change my RSVP" → RSVP form (until May 1) · Add to calendar

notes.text: This email is how a guest gets back to their RSVP later. No account needed.

name: Guest reminder (one week to go)
from: Automatic: 1 week before (and a short text 1 day before)
next: "Directions" → maps · "Event details" → Event Website

notes.text: Was a gap in round 2. Day-before text: "See you tomorrow at 4 PM! Directions: yourbiz.link/d/rivera".
→ System: scheduled per event; skipped for guests who declined; respects STOP opt-outs.

name: Team invite text
from: Owner clicks "Invite staff" in Settings › Team & roles
next: Tap link → Staff Invite + Sign In

notes.text: Can also go by email. The link knows which business and role Sam was invited to.

name: Staff Invite + Sign In
next: Download app → sign in with code → Profile

notes.text: → System: links the staff member to the business with the role the owner set.
No password to remember. Phone number + SMS code only.

name: Staff Profile
next: Save → wait for shifts (My Shifts unlocks in Phase 2)

notes.text: My Shifts / Day-of / Chat are shown locked: they arrive in Phase 2, so P1 has no dead-end tabs.
Staff never see money unless the owner grants it.
